repository_policy_observation.interpretation: CI workflow metrics are feedback proxies, not proof of a required merge gate.

ci_workflow_elapsed_seconds.method: updated_at - created_at; median is the mean of the two middle values for even n; p95 uses nearest-rank

limitations: Workflow elapsed time is a proxy, not developer waiting time or engineering productivity.
Failed workflow runs are included in elapsed-time statistics; workflow failure can reflect code, tests, or infrastructure.
The unit is a workflow run, not a distinct pull request; multiple commits on one PR can create multiple run_attempt=1 records.
The observed CI workflow is not a configured branch-protection required status check on main.
The pass rate is descriptive and does not establish that a specific change caused CI outcomes.
This is a single 30-day repository snapshot; compare future windows with identical filters and inspect sample composition before acting.
